title: Intellicheck to Report Q3 2026 Results on November 12 | Intellicheck
summary: Intellicheck (Nasdaq: IDN) will release Q3 2026 financial results Nov. 12 and host a conference call and webcast. Get dial-in and webcast details.
body_markdown:
MELVILLE, NEW YORK – October 30, 2026 –[Intellicheck](https://www.intellicheck.com/) , Inc. (Nasdaq: IDN), an industry-leading identity company delivering proprietary, on-demand digital and physical identification validation solutions, today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market close on Thursday, November 12, 2026, and host a conference call and simultaneous webcast at 4:30 PM ET / 1:30 PM PT that day. During the call, Intellicheck Chief Executive Officer Bryan Lewis and Chief Financial Officer Adam Sragovicz will review the Company’s financial results and provide a business update, followed by a question-and-answer session.


‍


**Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call and Webcast Details**


- **Date / Time:** Thursday, November 12 at 4:30 PM ET / 1:30 PM PT
- **Webcast:**[https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=Fki5dHUA](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=Fki5dHUA)
- **U.S. Dial-in:** 877-407-8037
- **International Dial-in:** +1 201-689-8037


A replay of the conference call will be available approximately three hours after the completion of the live event and will remain available until November 19, 2026. To listen to the replay, please dial 877-660-6853 and use conference identification number 13762981. For callers outside the U.S., please dial 201-612-7415 and use conference identification number 13762981.


‍


**About Intellicheck**


Intellicheck (Nasdaq: IDN), the industry leader in identity verification management, prevents the use of unauthorized IDs to stop identity-based fraud. Intellicheck is the only SaaS-based validation and proofing service that uses a unique and proprietary analysis of DMV-issued IDs to create trusted, real-time customer identity verification experiences across a wide variety of sectors, both in-person and digitally. Intellicheck is processing identity transactions for almost half the adult population in the United States and Canada annually with state-of-the-art technology solutions that are providing a seamless, invisible ID verification experience while delivering 99.975% decisioning in under a second when a customer is using our tools to capture the document. For more information on Intellicheck, visit us on the[web](https://intellicheck.com/?utm_source=pr) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intellicheck-inc-) ,[X](https://twitter.com/IDNIntellicheck) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/intellicheckidn/) , and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@IntellicheckIDN) .
